_comment: kn_brain community feed (services/brain/community.c, doc/backend.md 'Community feed'). Copy to config/community.json (or set brain.community.feed); the brain rereads it when it changes. news: the What's New window and the hub's News tab; events / polls: the menu's Community & Events popup. Dates are UTC ISO 8601. Events past ended_at (else start_date + duration_hours) and polls past ends_at are not served.

gameEvents._comment: A live event (Krunker v10.0.3 ongoingEvents, doc/v10/kill-pools.md): from startsAt to endsAt, every public match draws its kill pools once per kill (at most 30) for each signed-in player. killPoolsWeight: the event's share of a draw (percent); killPoolsMode: dilute (shrinks earlier events' shares) or add; killPoolsIcon: ui/img/<icon>.webp on the end screen's Collect button. Only skin contents pay.
